title: Ashbury Rewards Console Reference: Welcome Points Posting
content:
Elite members receive welcome points in one welcome points transaction per stay naming the stay, posted on the Ashbury Rewards account when the folio is settled; that one posting may carry the welcome amount more than once, so the tier setting that welcome points are given once per stay is read as one welcome posting per stay and no longer as one welcome amount regardless of the number of nights.

## Conditions of the result

- Reward Night Rate stays receive welcome points when the tier's setting gives welcome points on Reward Night Rate stays.
- Reservations booked through an online travel agency receive none.
- The tier is read as under the Ashbury Rewards stay earning rules, and when it cannot be read the welcome points are left to Ashbury Rewards member services.
- A stay receives welcome points at most once.
- Welcome points are posted only to a membership whose status is active.

## Capability

`post_stay_welcome_points_0494e852` posts the welcome points of a completed elite stay to an Ashbury Rewards account. One call records one points bonus transaction that names the stay, dated today, and adds the points to the points balance of the membership. The member sees the welcome points in their account activity and in their balance straight away.

## Invocation

An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, giving the name `post_stay_welcome_points_0494e852`, and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `loyalty_member_id` | Reference number of the Ashbury Rewards membership credited, as returned by the membership lookup for the verified member | Identifier |
| `reservation_id` | Reference number of the completed stay the welcome points are for, as returned by the reservation lookup | Identifier |
| `earning_source` | Business source recorded on the transaction | Closed set of one value: `welcome_amenity` — the welcome points an elite member receives for a stay |
| `promotion_code` | Code of a registered promotion the points would be earned under, upper-case letters and digits, up to 10 characters | Welcome points are earned under no promotion, so the value is the empty string "" |
| `points` | Welcome points posted | Whole number of points, always positive; integer, no decimals, no thousands separators |

## Return

A dictionary string with `transaction_id` (reference number of the bonus transaction created), `loyalty_member_id` (membership credited), `reservation_id` (stay named), `earning_source` (source recorded), `points` (integer points posted), `posted_date` (posting date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `points_balance` (points balance once the welcome points are added). A returned `transaction_id` means the welcome points are posted.
